# Sustainability plan template

A sustainability plan answers one question: what happens to the dataset after the grant ends? A dataset with a named steward, a stable home and a way to pay for upkeep can keep being used and corrected. Without these, it often becomes hard to find, out of date or unavailable. Some funders ask for a plan like this, but it is worth writing for your own project in any case.

## When to use this template

- **At project design**, to think the questions through early.
- **In the last months of the grant**, to update the plan and put it into action.

## What this plan covers

Who looks after the data once the funding ends, where it lives, how errors and updates are handled, what this costs, and who pays.

## How to fill it in

Copy everything below the divider into your project files. Replace each `[bracketed field]` with your own answer. Write "not decided yet" rather than leaving a field empty, so that gaps are visible.

---

## Part 1. Project and dataset overview

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Dataset name and version | `[name, version]` |
| What the dataset is | `[one or two sentences]` |
| Who it serves | `[communities, researchers, developers]` |

## Part 2. Stewardship and governance after the grant

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Steward (who looks after the data) | `[named community body or institution]` |
| Who makes decisions about the data | `[decision rights pass to ...]` |
| Contact person and backup | `[names or roles]` |

## Part 3. Hosting and access

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Where the dataset will stay available | `[stable host, e.g. Hugging Face, Zenodo, an institutional repository]` |
| Stable identifier | `[e.g. a DOI]` |
| Licence | `[licence chosen for the release]` |

## Part 4. Community maintenance and updates

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Where errors and updates are reported | `[issue tracker / forum]` |
| Who responds, and how quickly | `[who, expected response time]` |
| How new versions are released | `[process]` |

## Part 5. Translation and localisation

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Plans to add languages or varieties | `[yes / no / later]` |
| How that work will be done | `[described here]` |

## Part 6. Funding and resources beyond the grant

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Running costs per year | `[steward time, corrections, hosting]` |
| Period these estimates cover | `[e.g. the next five years]` |
| Who pays | `[institutional support / follow-on funding / in-kind community effort]` |
| Paid services, if any | `[e.g. custom annotation or training; services must not close the data or conflict with the licence in Part 3]` |

## Part 7. Risks and contingency

| Risk | How you will reduce it |
|---|---|
| `[e.g. host shuts down]` | `[plan]` |
| `[e.g. key people leave]` | `[plan]` |

## Part 8. Milestones and review schedule

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| How often the plan is reviewed | `[cadence]` |
| Next review date | `[YYYY-MM-DD]` |
| Key milestones | `[list]` |

---

Sustainability is the lifecycle question seen from the funding side. It connects directly to [Maintenance](../9_dataset-lifecycle/maintenance.md) and [Community](../10_community-collaboration/community-ecosystem.md).
